lansync.title: How LAN Network Sync Works
lansync.subtitle: Share patient data between workstations on your local network — no cloud, no delays, no GDPR risk.

step1.title: 1. Set Up a Shared Folder
step1.desc: Point PISUM to a shared network folder (NAS, SMB share, or mapped drive). All workstations on the same network access a single database.

step2.title: 2. One Shared Password
step2.desc: The database is AES-256 encrypted. Set a single password on the first workstation — all other PCs will enter the same password to connect.

step3.title: 3. Instant Sync Across PCs
step3.desc: Each workstation reads and writes data directly to the shared database. Changes are instantly reflected across all connected computers.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.intro: Everything you need to know before subscribing.
faq.q1: Can I change my plan at any time?
faq.a1: Yes — you can upgrade or cancel your subscription anytime from your dashboard. Changes take effect immediately.
faq.q2: Is there a minimum commitment period?
faq.a2: No. All plans are billed monthly with no commitments. Annual billing saves you 20% compared to monthly. You can cancel your subscription anytime from your dashboard.
faq.q3: Is the Free plan truly free?
faq.a3: Yes — no credit card required, no time limits. The Free plan allows you to explore PISUM with 10 templates, 50 reports per month, and PDF export. Upgrade when you're ready.
faq.a4: AI Dictation converts your voice into structured radiological report text in real-time. It operates via a secure API — audio recordings are never stored. Your monthly limit resets on the 1st of each month.
faq.a5: All payments are processed by Lemon Squeezy, a PCI-compliant platform. PISUM never stores your banking details.
faq.q6: Where is my data stored? Is PISUM GDPR compliant?
faq.a6: Your patient reports are stored locally on your computer — PISUM never uploads clinical data to the cloud. Account data (name, email, subscription status) is hosted on Supabase with servers in the EU. PISUM is fully GDPR compliant.
faq.q7: Does PISUM require an internet connection?
faq.a7: Yes. PISUM requires an active internet connection for AI Dictation, AI Enhancer, and subscription management. Your patient reports and templates are stored locally on your computer, but AI features securely connect to our cloud API.
faq.q8: Is there a free trial for paid plans?
faq.a8: The Free plan is a permanent free tier — no time limits, no credit card required. Starter, Pro, and Expert include a 14-day free trial, allowing you to evaluate the full feature set risk-free before you're charged. All paid plans come with a 30-day money-back guarantee.
